availableCommands.name: context-management
availableCommands.description: Decide when to compact or clear context at a safe sub-task boundary, and continue the active goal.

configOptions.name: Model
configOptions.description: The model the next generation uses.

configOptions.name: Reasoning effort
configOptions.description: How much the model is asked to think, within what it supports.

configOptions.name: Mode
configOptions.description: The permission mode the next generation is judged under. auto is unavailable in this session. It needs a configured [permissions] judge: ego config set 'permissions.judge="openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol"'. If this session uses a profile, add --profile <name> to that command. Start a new session after configuration. The session max_mode can also restrict auto.

configOptions.name: Sandbox
configOptions.description: How much of the filesystem a command this session runs can reach. The list is what the operator who started this process allowed and this machine can enforce; it can be narrowed here and not widened.
